presentation.notes: Formal Linux window comparisons include matched 22-metre input, original PNGs, near/army cameras and 36 contact records. The normal screenshot is the live 22-metre follow camera. Extra garment, archery and bank pilot comparisons have their own provenance in STUDIES.md.
failures_retained: Separate diagnostic warm wood tested positive for skin; fabric/hand application revised and actual material IDs inspected independent of the old RGB count.
Early moored prop flooded through the seats; the water surface now terminates inside the hull.
Smooth light-green terrain and flat-ended crowns rejected in field views.
Small shield-side hands, repeated soldier faces, layered inland canopy shapes and superimposed long weapons remain visible.
